intent: Two sessions reading their own virtual displays at the same moment must not kill each other's dump.
scope: python_pkg/android_ui/_a11y_helper.py (lock), driver.py (passes the serial), tests, README
changes: dump_display runs install + am instrument under a per-phone flock at ~/.cache/android_ui/a11ydump-<serial>.lock
AndroidUi passes its serial so different phones do not queue behind each other

verification.command: live two-session run on the Pixel 6a before the fix (fake owners claude:fakeA / claude:fakeB, 300 s)
verification.evidence: logcat: 'stop com.kuhy.a11ydump due to start instr' then 'Crash of app com.kuhy.a11ydump running instrumentation'; android_ui: 'a11y helper returned no tree: Process crashed'

verification.command: same run after the fix: /tmp/two_session/run.sh, DURATION=300
verification.evidence: A 219 element taps on Calculator (display 14), B 440 dp taps + dumps on Clock (display 13), 0 failures, empty stderr; 99 samples: display 0 stayed on Signal, 14 on Calculator, 13 on Clock; all five alarms still off

verification.command: raw adb from a Claude Bash call while claude:fakeA held pkg:__screen__
verification.evidence: `adb shell input -d 0 tap` blocked after 40 s naming claude:fakeA; `input keyevent 0` without -d blocked at once; `input -d 13 tap` refused as claude_fakeB's display
153 passed; every module 100% line and branch

risks: The lock is per host: sessions on another machine sharing the phone over adb are not serialised.
